notes.title: The most long-awaited update! There is a voice acting in the game!
notes.notes:
Meet the most long-awaited update! Finally, this is the best game in the world with voice acting!
The voice acting is done by professional actors, and conveys the full charm of the game as much as possible!  Moreover, the game was originally developed for this voiceover! Now every dialogue, every remark is filled with life and emotions, immersing the player into the game world with his head. 
 
To get acquainted with the voices of your favorite characters, explore unknown places, solve riddles, communicate with characters and complete additional tasks that will help reveal the plot from a new angle.  
  
But that's not all! The update includes many other improvements.:  
  
• Better animations: The animations in the game have been redesigned and now look smoother, which significantly improves the quality of the gameplay.  
  
• Speed: Now you don't have to wait for Ivan to get to the right place for a long time. We have optimized the character's characteristics, making it much faster. This will allow you to travel around locations even more efficiently and enjoy dynamic gameplay.  
  
We invite everyone to personally evaluate all the innovations. This update is not just a technical improvement, but a real New Year's miracle!

notes.title: Update 1.2.2
Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
This update adds new quests and a few new characters!

[h3][b]Meet the new character, the Fir-Man![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39903166/cebdeee784720e45c7fac3de46c4859c8af059a0.jpg[/img]

Help him sort out his problems and find the best Christmas tree in his life!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39903166/51da5171ba9abce05d3bcae63b7fe66cd655f09b.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Find out the secret of Petrovich![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39903166/52c84b60dd2d45d724b3cf601f91b85c4312d735.jpg[/img]
Why is his name different from other characters? Why does he live on the outskirts and does not like guests?

[h3][b]In addition, in the update:[/b][/h3]

New news and newspaper headlines:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39903166/124bc151884ad0956ab69835d74c4d671f982147.jpg[/img]

New transportable items:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39903166/5eb8215cd330a0d8ae51c9e8e116881bc6564bd3.jpg[/img]

Changes:
[list]
[*] The delay when throwing an item has been reduced to 1 second;
[*] The maximum number of wolves in the forest has been reduced. Now walking in the forest is not so difficult :)
[*] The damage of wolves has been reduced. Now the chance to carry the item in your hands is higher;
[*] The characters involved in the plot are now, as a rule, with the lights on;
[*] The NKVD, for writing denunciations, is now available from the very beginning.
[/list]


Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with a huge weapon after loading from save;
[*] Fixed a bug with not displaying some items in the hands;
[*] The bug with the movement of wolves through the air has been fixed;
[*] A bunch of small bugs that I have already forgotten have been fixed :)
[/list]
